biggest_catch: You pay to ship the comics to them, and their grading is strict - if they grade lower than you did, the offer drops (you can have the comics returned instead).
catches: You ship the comics at your own cost; factor postage into whether a small lot is worth it.
Strict in-house grading: books graded lower than you recorded get a proportionally lower offer (or return).
Check is mailed within 2 business days of completed sale, but grading happens after receipt with no official grading-time SLA - allow extra days before the sale completes.
Mailed check adds postal transit on top; instant trade credit is not cash.
costs_and_unpaid_time: You pay shipping to them; no seller fees; ~30-60 min active (look up issues, grade, pack, ship).

demand_side: The venue is mycomicshop.com itself (the buyer). Demand side = their comic retail operation, which publishes a live want list with buy prices per issue and grade. You reach it today at mycomicshop.com/webuycomics - look up your issues to see exactly what they'll pay before committing. You get 'picked' by submitting your sale list; they authorize the shipment and pay after grading.
eligibility: Anyone who owns comics on their want list (any publisher/era); books must be shippable and gradable.
maximize: Grade conservatively using their grading guide so the offer holds; batch enough books to make your postage worthwhile; choose trade credit only if you'll actually shop there - otherwise take the check.
notes: Comic-book direct buyout is an uncovered niche. Using the want-list BUYOUT path only (not consignment, which pays weeks later after resale). Their lead developer publicly states over 100,000 comics a month are bought from individual sellers via the online buying system - real purchase volume.

steps: Go to mycomicshop.com/webuycomics and look up your issues on the online want list to see the buy price per grade.
Record the comics you want to sell (barcode scanner optional for modern books).
Submit your sale list; they respond authorizing you to ship and confirming the offer as you graded.
Print their shipping invoice, pack the comics, and ship them at your cost.
They grade on receipt: match = original offer paid; higher grade = proportionally more; lower grade = accept reduced offer or have books returned.
When the sale is complete, a check is mailed within two business days (or instant trade credit to your account).
timing: List and ship at your pace; they grade after receipt (no official grading-time SLA); check mailed within 2 business days of completed sale.
what_gets_accepted: Comic books on their want list across publishers and eras; graded in-hand - strict grading, lower-than-recorded grades reduce the offer; Quick Sale path takes cover-price $0.60-and-under books in bulk lots.
when_cash_arrives: Check mailed within 2 business days of the completed sale (after their grading); allow postal transit on top - realistic door-to-door ~7-14 days from shipment. Trade credit is immediate but is store credit, not cash.
who_pays: MyComicShop, a large comic retailer that resells the comics it buys.
who_qualifies: A human who owns physical comics and can ship them - the buyer needs your actual books for in-hand grading; AI cannot own or ship comics.
work_available: Always available - standing want-list buy program with published prices.
